trainer.dialogueBefore: Pokémon Ranger Deshawn: A quiet wood, a still pond... and a ranger behind every tree. Halt!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Pokémon Ranger Deshawn: Carry on. Mind the flower beds.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Felix: East or west, whichever way you're going, the road runs through me!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Felix: Right through me, as it turns out.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Dana: Everyone hurries past to the Resort Area. Nobody's on holiday until they've battled me!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Dana: Enjoy the resort. You've earned the rest.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Sandra: Earth, lightning and fire! I never did decide on a favourite, so I brought all three.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Sandra: All three, beaten one after another. At least that's fair.
